name: io.github.alfgarbel/ogsmith
title: OGsmith
description: Render, preview and save Open Graph social card images with the OGsmith API.

environmentVariables.name: OGSMITH_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your og_… API key from the OGsmith dashboard. Without it, cards render with the demo watermark.

environmentVariables.name: OGSMITH_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for saved PNGs and batch zips. Defaults to ~/OGsmith.
